title: Severe Weather / Lightning
steps: Suspend play per IPL safety matrix when lightning is within 8 km; evacuate open-air seating at 5 km.
Activate PA: direct fans to nearest covered concourse or stamped shelter zone.
Close exposed gates (terraces, parking) and hold ingress to open-air zones.
Dispatch weather desk to confirm MET feed every 2 minutes.
Log all gate closures and shelter occupancy for post-event review.

title: Crowd Crush / Surge
steps: Immediate hold on ingress to affected sector; open alternate egress paths.
Deploy stewards to form perpendicular flow lanes — never oppose crowd momentum.
Issue digital signage and push routing fans to alternate gates with incentives if needed.
Alert medical teams to stage at concourse choke points.
Escalate to incident commander if density exceeds 90% for more than 3 minutes.

title: Power Outage
steps: Switch command center to UPS and enable radio backup channels.
Illuminate emergency egress with battery backup lighting paths.
Pause escalators; post stewards at stairwell landings.
Verify ticket scanners on offline whitelist mode.
Coordinate with utility vendor; update fans every 10 minutes via SMS.

title: Mass Casualty Medical
steps: Establish triage point upwind of incident, minimum 50m from crowd flow.
Clear corridor for ambulance access via nearest vehicle gate.
Pause unrelated announcements; single spokesperson for PA.
Document timeline and CCTV bookmark from T-5 to T+15 minutes.
